name: jarvis-system-admin
description: Audited, policy-governed system administration control plane for Codex

interface.shortDescription: Govern and audit system administration workflows.
interface.longDescription: Jarvis System Admin provides capability registration, deterministic policy decisions, command-scoped approvals, version-aware knowledge records, error and lesson lifecycles, state records, and tamper-evident audit events for least-privilege Codex administration.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $jarvis-control-plane to classify this administration request, identify required evidence and approval, and create an auditable execution plan. Do not execute unapproved changes.
